description: List recent or bounded historical SEC filings with canonical source metadata and explicit coverage limits. Use this when you need form, filing-date, or accession inventory, when choosing an exact pair for filedproof.compare_filings, or when confirming coverage before filedproof.check_disclosure_changes. For passage-level research, use filedproof.search_evidence instead.

forms.description: SEC filing form types to include, such as 10-K, 10-Q, or 8-K.

history.description: Whether to use bounded historical SEC submission archives when needed.

identifier.description: Ticker, CIK, or exact SEC company name.

limit.description: Maximum number of operation-specific evidence or result records to return.

name: filedproof.list_filings

outputSchema.description: Structured FiledProof result with operation-specific evidence, provenance, coverage, and uncertainty fields.

title: List SEC filings
